notes: I changed the model from a single global quadratic to a piecewise function: a flat dead zone at y = -22.8021 for |x| ≤ 5 (clearly visible in E2 where x = -5..5 all give exactly -22.8021), and a quadratic with a slight linear term for |x| > 5. The previous model predicted a smooth parabola through zero, which missed the flat region entirely and got the curvature wrong.
